_meta.purpose: Compact reviewed positive Japanese-use Han scope evidence for characters not safely covered by ordinary KANJIDIC lookup alone.
_meta.policy: Positive-scope evidence only. Japanese readings may be exposed as candidates, but this bank must never force one reading when several legitimate readings remain. Chinese/Korean readings are not imported.

researchReview.method: All 269 previously unknown KANJIDIC Han were researched as one set before implementation. Japanese dictionary/infrastructure evidence was preferred; Unicode Japanese-specific properties were secondary only. Component names and explicitly provisional/convenience readings were not promoted.
